anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all timeframes (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, no opportunities generated, and no adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system crashes.
Review and potentially restart the AI module to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the active trading strategies to ensure they are being executed properly.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect the performance of trading operations.
